facts.value: Erasmus+ DELTA is an opportunity to engage with the existing Erasmus+ mobility programme for all staff who teach in Irish higher education.

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Delta Scholarships + Process for UL Staff

facts.value: Staff undertaking training in the development of pedagogical and curriculum design skills can apply for a DELTA Scholarship.

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Delta Scholarships + Process for UL Staff

facts.value: DELTA stands for Disciplinary Excellence in Learning, Teaching and Assessment and is a core concept of the work of the National Forum.

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Delta Scholarships + Process for UL Staff

facts.value: This initiative is the result of a partnership between the National Forum and the Higher Education Authority, building on the success of the existing Erasmus+ mobility programme.

metadata.chunk_title: Erasmus+ Delta Scholarships + Process for UL Staff

facts.value: Erasmus+ DELTA focuses on supporting the professional development of all staff who teach in Irish higher education, with a particular focus on the enhancement of teaching and learning within and between disciplines.

facts.value: Funding is allocated on a first come basis. In order to maximise funding, the maximum duration is 5 working days excluding travel time.

facts.value: Identify the organisation you will visit and obtain permission from the organisation as well as your line manager. Discuss the type of activities you wish to undertake and create a programme of activities in collaboration with the host organisation.
